The workbook contains **1 sheet** named "Sheet1" - **7 columns total:** Location, Burgers, Hot Dogs, Salads, Fries, Ice Cream, Soda - **9 data rows** representing different locations: Pinebrook, Wharvton, Sagrada, Algrimand, Marztep, San Cecelia, Pimento, Tinseles, Rosdale -
